name: Particle-Based Fire
definition: The most efficient and well-understood way to render fuzzy phenomena in real-time. Consists of a particle emitter regulating behavior/appearance and particles simulated with graphical primitives (pixels/polygons).
summary: Particle-based fire is a real-time rendering technique that decomposes fire into discrete particles, offering an efficient alternative to volumetric rendering by using splatting rather than continuous volume fields.
